title: Bishop Nathanyel: understanding on Matthew 18:21 #IUIC #IsraelUnitedInChrist #Nathanyel7 #Short
segments: Israelite Christ, bless. I was doing a
little reading on Matthew 18 regarding
forgiveness.
In Matthew 18:21, the Apostle Peter
asked Christ, "How often shall my
brother offend me and I forgive him?
Seven times?" In verse 22, Christ said,
"No, I don't say seven times. I say unto
you forgive him 70 * 70." And you and I
stress over that because what if he
steals from us? WHAT IF HE ROBS US? 70 *
70, HE'S GOING TO KEEP DOING IT? NO,
ISRAEL.
When you've done something wrong, the
first thing in order to get forgiveness,
you have to admit you've done something
wrong and be sorry for it. NO ONE EVER
CHOKED to death by swallowing pride,
okay? And the next thing you have to
understand is that although you can
apologize, YOU CAN ACCEPT THAT APOLOGY.
"Apology accepted, but trust denied."
I'm going to say it again, "Apology
accepted, but trust denied."
Facts.
